4935.title: Pi image completion classification
4935.rootCauseOneLine: Pi completion preserves the generic read shape instead of classifying a successful image result with its known path.
4935.proposedFix: Promote validated successful native image reads to the existing imageView shape while preserving the provider item key and original path.
4935.caveats: Translation reproduced twice on trusted main; live Pi execution, browser previews and host-file loading remain unverified.
